Nekone asks, her voice quavering.
Dear brothe--

B-Brother...?
Don't tell me he's--
...Kuon, please.
Of course.
After entering the cell, Kuon silently examines\n
Oshtor for a moment... and sighs softly.
It's all right. He's just unconscious.
Thank goodness...
...Ah... Nekone.
Oshtor stirs, managing only a raspy murmur.
Dear brother...!
Nekone pulls Oshtor in a tight embrace without\n
even bothering to wipe her tears.
Haku, everyone... You came.
Yeah, we sure did. Can you stand?
Yes... We must... make haste.
door_close
We unbind him from the chains, and lend him\n
a hand as he slowly rises.
Below his ragged clothes, we can see reddened stripes\n
and wounds from the lashes covering his body.
He... withstood all that pain up to now?
Nekone hastens to Oshtor's side in an attempt\n
to support his weight.
Oshtor looks down at her, his eyes softening,\n
and gently holds her close.
Dear brother...
At that, Nekone finally relaxes, the terrified\n
tension draining from her expression and body.
Drink this. It'll only be a temporary fix, but\n
it should help with the pain.
Kuon takes out a pouch of medicine and hands it\n
to Oshtor.
Ah... My thanks.
If we had the time, I would've preferred to give\n
you proper treatment...
No need. I can already feel the medicine working.\n
But we must move swiftly--Her Highness is in\n
grave danger.
We know. Oshtor, do you have any idea where the\n
princess would be?
It's only a matter of time until they realize\n
we're here. We don't have the luxury of searching.
Her Highness's sleeping quarters are at the apex\n
of the innermost building. I know... she is there...
At my nod, Oshtor puts all his weight on his own\n
legs, and tries to walk forward.
Dear brother! You must not push yourself like that...
She's right. You can leave the rescue of\n
Her Highness to us.
That's right. You need to escape quickly, brother...
I am sorry, but... I must go.
Whether or not my limbs can move, I will go to her.\n
Even if I must crawl, I will go to her...
Even Oshtor--stoic, calm, composed Oshtor--\n
has totally lost his cool...
Guess that just shows how bad the situation's\n
gotten.
Lady-in-waiting
Um... If that is the case, I do not mind helping\n
you walk.
Please, take my hand.
You are...?
My apologies for the belated introduction.\n
I am the one in charge of Her Highness's\n
well-being.
She's the one who told us you were being held\n
in this prison.
I am truly sorry, Lord Oshtor. This is all my\n
fault...
Sorry, but I'll have to ask you to save that stuff\n
for later. We don't have time to stand around\n
apologizing.
Uruuru, Saraana, could you do your... thing?\n
One more time?
...As you wish.
Oshtor, are you OK walking?
If you slow us down, I swear I'm just gonna\n
leave you in a ditch somewhere.
I would have it no other way.
This is how it must be, Nekone. We have no time.\n
I would rather fall behind than hinder you all.
...I will help you walk.
Nekone--
I WILL help you walk.
Anju's caretaker also stands beside Oshtor,\n
supporting him.
I cannot fight like the rest of you...\n
So please, allow me to help in this small way.
Just let them handle it, Oshtor.\n
Otherwise we'll be wasting all our time here\n
arguing about it.
I suppose so... Thank you, you two.
I-It is nothing...
You good to go, Oshtor?
Yes. Sorry for keeping you.
Don't worry about it.
We continue onward to the top of the building,\n
through the dense fog.
We pass by several patrols on the way, but thanks\n
to the barrier, nobody spots us.
I sneak a look at Oshtor, walking alongside me.
He's definitely not looking good...
His footsteps are heavy and slow...\n
It's like looking at a completely different person.
Oshtor's wounds must be a lot more serious\n
than he's letting on.
...Hey, Oshtor.
Hm?
Maybe this isn't the best time, but...
It is unlike you to dance around a subject so.
Well, I guess I'll just be blunt...\n
Is the Mikado really dead?
...Yes. Without doubt.
I have seen my liege's body with my own eyes.
I hear Kiwru and the others' breathing skip\n
for a moment.
I'm sure there was a part of them that hoped\n
it wasn't true, like I did...
It is believed that the ones responsible for his\n
death are Lady Honoka and myself.
Yeah. I heard the Mikado's meal was poisoned...
So the real culprit is still in the imperial\n
capital somewhere, waiting for a chance to strike?
Regardless...
I see. So... he really is gone.
The keeper of lost technology, the man who lived\n
for centuries...\n
My brother... is dead.
And it happened just like that...
He just appeared before me as the Mikado, and\n
without any warning, he disappeared from me.
It's so sudden. I know I should be sad, but...\n
why can't I shed any tears for him?
I'm sure if he could see me now, he'd just laugh\n
and tell me what a heartless brother I am.
What's certain, at least, is that now...\n
there's no one left who knows about my past.
...The top floor is just ahead.\n
We should hurry, Haku.
Sure... Right.
Uzurushan Soldier
The bravest warrior of Uzurusha is eternal!
Dammit. Not you again...
Almighty overlord, I have returned!
And I have come to prove that the brave warriors\n
of Uzurusha are the bravest of brave warriors!
We shall take the title of almighty overlord\n
for ourselves!
Now then! To battle!
I genuinely could not care less. Look, seriously,\n
you can HAVE the name.
Uzurushan Soldier
Gghh... We lost.
But I shall not give up! One day I shall prove\n
that the warriors of Uzurusha are true brave\n
warriors.
Until then, you may uphold the name of the\n
almighty overlord with pride!
Please, take the name. Honestly.\n
I do NOT care.
Very fitting for you.
The almighty bonerlord. Very distinguished.\n
It truly embodies the essence of your\n
character, master.
And THAT'S not any better!
